title: claude plugin eval cannot run against the repo root; CI and the README need a staged plugin dir
context: FR-16 and the README steps say run 'claude plugin eval .' from the checkout. A real run from the repo root failed every case with: 'a plugin directory holds more than 20000 entries to check for eval directories, point the case at a smaller plugin directory'. The checkout has about 97k entries outside node_modules (.git, graph-ui, coverage) plus node_modules, and CI's fresh checkout plus pnpm install is also far over 20000. The probe passed because it used a slim copy (.claude-plugin, assets, dist, runtime, package.json, evals, and node_modules as a symlink, which the walker does not follow). A run from such a staged copy (scratchpad/posroute/result.json) loaded plugin 'paqad' and graded correctly. The scaffold already computes the plugin root from BASH_SOURCE, so it works unchanged from a staged copy.
